eyebrow: What runs it, what it runs on
code:
trigger:
  branches:
    include:
      - main

pr:
  branches:
    include:
      - main

pool:
  vmImage: "ubuntu-latest"
caption: trigger controls CI on push; pr controls validation builds; pool picks the agent.

code:
jobs:
  - job: BuildAndTest
    steps:
      - checkout: self
      - task: UseNode@3
        inputs:
          version: "20.x"
      - script: npm ci
      - script: npm test -- --ci
caption: A task is a pre-built catalog step; a script runs a raw shell command.

code:
- task: Docker@2
  inputs:
    containerRegistry: "northbridgeRetailACR"
    repository: "storefront-api"
    command: "buildAndPush"
    Dockerfile: "**/Dockerfile"
    tags: |
      $(Build.BuildId)
caption: containerRegistry points at a service connection — covered fully in Lesson 14.
